nodes.label: speckit-analyze
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Cross-artifact analysis is read-only and treats constitution conflicts as critical.

nodes.label: speckit-checklist
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Checklists validate requirements quality; checked custom items indicate reviewer approval, not implemented behavior.

nodes.label: speckit-clarify
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: At most five targeted questions reduce ambiguity and record answers directly in the specification.

nodes.label: speckit-constitution
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Only the constitution is changed; dependent templates read it at runtime.

nodes.label: speckit-converge
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Implementation gaps become append-only tasks without modifying existing tasks or application code.

nodes.label: speckit-implement
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Executes dependency-ordered tasks and records completed task checkboxes.

nodes.label: speckit-plan
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Research resolves unknowns before data models, contracts, and quickstart guidance are generated.

nodes.label: speckit-specify
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Specifications focus on user needs and measurable outcomes, leaving implementation details to planning.

nodes.label: speckit-tasks
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Tasks are organized by independently testable user stories with explicit file paths and dependency markers.

nodes.label: speckit-taskstoissues
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Task IDs are deduplicated across open and closed GitHub issues, and issue creation is restricted to the origin repository.

nodes.label: Whisper media transcription
nodes.rationale: Domain hints from graph node labels improve transcription context; transcripts become documents.

nodes.label: Graphify incremental update and clustering
nodes.rationale: Only changed files are re-extracted; deleted sources are pruned and changed sources are replaced.

nodes.label: Structural AST extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic code extraction runs without an API key and in parallel with semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Semantic document extraction
nodes.rationale: Documents, papers, and images are extracted by Gemini when configured or by host agents otherwise.

nodes.label: Constrained query vocabulary expansion
nodes.rationale: Substring matching lacks stemming and synonyms; graph vocabulary is selected before traversal.

nodes.label: Graphify query work memory
nodes.rationale: Saved answers and outcomes feed preferred sources, known dead ends, and corrections into future graph sessions.

nodes.label: Graph integrity diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Read-only diagnostics expose dangling endpoints, self-loops, and edge collapse without aborting the graph build.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages deployment
nodes.rationale: Only live and methods pages are published because the comparison page needs local renders.

nodes.label: Readable Explicit Python
nodes.rationale: Descriptive names, types and numerical shapes make scientific code reviewable.

nodes.label: Meaningful Automated Tests
nodes.rationale: Tests assert observable behavior using synthetic fixtures and isolated external effects.

nodes.label: Numerical and Integration Correctness
nodes.rationale: Contracts for missing landmarks, timing, units and live latency protect the movement-to-sound relationship.

nodes.label: Maintainable Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Separating computation from devices and file access reduces reuse and maintenance costs.

nodes.label: Reproducible Environments
nodes.source_location: V. Reproducible Environments and Diagnosable Failures

nodes.label: Requirements Quality Checklist
nodes.rationale: Checked items record reviewer-confirmed requirements quality, not implementation completion.

nodes.label: Specification and Plan Review Gates
nodes.rationale: Rejecting a generated specification or plan aborts the workflow.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph Navigation
nodes.rationale: Scoped query, path and explain results reduce raw source browsing; AST updates keep the map current.

nodes.label: Ball Between the Hands
nodes.rationale: A visible object makes the mapping readable: midpoint sets position, hand separation sets size, movement excites sound.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Bounce Template Proposal
nodes.rationale: A learned observation template is proposed to correct roughly 40 ms late beats without chasing the phase estimate.

nodes.label: Offline Mapping Matrix Proposal
nodes.rationale: Sharing the live mapping matrix with the offline renderer would align demo and performance mappings.

nodes.source_location: Dance â†’ the rope's music engine

nodes.label: Six Discovered Dance Shapes
nodes.rationale: The largest upright cluster is subdivided by arms because coarse upright poses represent different musical states.

nodes.label: Vocabulary Sonification
nodes.rationale: No clock or drums are used because these dances have no stable pulse; shape changes move harmony.

nodes.label: Motion Driven Synthesis
nodes.rationale: Speed drives loudness so stillness is silence; other features color the sound.

nodes.label: Remembered Stem Mixer
nodes.rationale: Volumes are remembered by layer name across demos.

nodes.label: Local Video Processing
nodes.rationale: All processing runs on the computer and no video leaves the browser.

nodes.label: Offline Motion Cleaning
nodes.rationale: Visibility gating, Hampel outlier removal and low-pass filtering remove tracker jitter; torso scaling is applied after derivatives to avoid false velocity.

nodes.label: Pooled Feature Normalisation
nodes.rationale: Pooling the three clips gives strong movement the same meaning across clips.

nodes.label: Weight Kinetic Energy
nodes.source_location: Weight (strong â†” light): peak kinetic energy

nodes.label: Time Acceleration
nodes.rationale: Weight and Time correlate around 0.94, so Time drives discrete sudden events rather than another continuous layer.

nodes.label: Flow Relative Jerk
nodes.rationale: Dividing jerk by acceleration separates jerkiness from intensity; a denominator floor avoids extreme readings during stillness.

nodes.label: Space Hand Path Straightness
nodes.source_location: Space (direct â†” indirect): path straightness of the hands

nodes.label: Minimum Motion Voice Leading
nodes.rationale: Trying pitch-class permutations minimizes total movement and prevents leaps when any of six chords follows any other.

nodes.label: Causal Live Motion Features
nodes.rationale: Only past samples exist in live performance, so filters and derivative windows need causal counterparts and measured time steps.

nodes.label: One Euro Filter
nodes.rationale: Slow joints get low cutoff to remove jitter; fast joints get higher cutoff for reduced lag.

nodes.label: Whole Body Rhythm Periodicity
nodes.rationale: Selecting the shortest strong autocorrelation peak prevents harmonic multiples from halving estimated tempo.

nodes.label: Bayesian Hip Bounce Tracking
nodes.source_location: 10d. Hip bounce and the locked groove
nodes.rationale: Raw hip landmarks bypass One Euro because the Bayesian model already smooths and another filter would shift beats.

nodes.label: Capture to Audio Clock Synchronization
nodes.source_location: 10d. Hip bounce and the locked groove
nodes.rationale: Capture times and output timestamps schedule audible beats at the actual hip bottom.

nodes.label: MediaPipe Hand Gesture Recognition
nodes.rationale: Wrist crops raise distant-hand detections from around 2% to 52â€“55%; debouncing prevents transient gesture actions.
